Updates `terser` from 5.51.2 to 5.51.3
<details>
<summary>Changelog</summary>

<blockquote>
<h2>v5.51.3</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix source code leak through sourceMap.content (input sourcemap)

</ul>
</blockquote>

Updates `webpack` from 5.112.2 to 5.113.0
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">webpack's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>v5.113.0</h2>
<h3>Minor Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Treat pure CommonJS exports and <code>require()</code> of pure modules as side-effect free. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​hai-x</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21937</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>compilation.hooks.chunkHashDependencies</code> for chunks naming other chunks. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22810</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add a <code>sourceTest</code> condition to <code>use</code> items; match <code>/g</code> regexps reliably. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​xiaoxiaojx</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#23029</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add optional SVG minification and preserve XML values and HTML style boundaries. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22692</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Allow <code>usedExports</code> and <code>mangleExports</code> with <code>cacheUnaffected</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#23337</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add an <code>updateManifest</code> HMR hook so plugins add their own hot update data. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#23008</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add a <code>transport</code> hook to <code>webpack.hmr.LazyCompilationPlugin</code>, so a development server can serve the lazy compilation backend from its own server, and pass the options it settles on to a custom backend, which can bring its own client. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#23435</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Restore deep import paths Module Federation loads and expose its helpers. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22934</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Load Node.js builtins in ESM output through <code>process.getBuiltinModule()</code>, warning where a universal target can't. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#23162</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Make the <code>MultiCompiler</code> <code>done</code> hook async; its sync <code>call</code> is deprecated. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#23023</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add a faster JavaScript <code>SourceProcessor</code> and drop <code>printer.load()</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22815</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>parseErrors</code> and every <code>ecmaVersion</code>; remove <code>JavascriptParser.extend</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22881</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Type a <code>&lt;style lang&gt;</code> or <code>&lt;script lang&gt;</code> body as its language's files. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22940</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Scope HTML <code>class</code> and <code>id</code> with a <code>&lt;style module&gt;</code> or linked CSS module. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#23279</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Let JavaScript parser hook taps read nodes through the path with <code>path: true</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#23234</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Let CSS visitors replace nodes and read value ranges, and minify CSS faster. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22886</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Drop unread call arguments and fold <code>Object.keys</code> and <code>.length</code> when minifying. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22871</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fix <code>delete (null ?? x)</code>, and drop unused catch bindings when minifying. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22878</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Merge branches spelling a key with and without quotes, drop the values an unread function called in place returns, write computed <code>NaN</code> and <code>null</code> keys as names, and drop <code>new</code> before <code>RegExp</code> of a BigInt when minifying. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​aryanraj45</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22914</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fold <code>switch</code>es, literals, trims, <code>typeof</code>, number members; inline more; drop unread classes, dead code, <code>?.</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22897</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Inline more calls, fold more, and merge imports and exports, when minifying. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22909</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fold a value into what an <code>await</code> or <code>yield</code> hands over, and a function or object assigned to a name read once into that read, when minifying. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​aryanraj45</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22920</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fold more values, tests and loop declarations when minifying. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22919</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fold a pure call's value past another pure call when minifying. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​aryanraj45</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22927</a>)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<!-- raw HTML omitted -->
</blockquote>
